title: Mekong Half Marathon 2026 Review: Vientiane's Riverside 21K from Green Step
seo_title: Mekong Half Marathon 2026 Review | Vientiane Laos Race
meta_description: The Mekong Half Marathon 2026: September 27 in Vientiane, Laos. 21K, 10K, 5K from Green Step with registration open — a Mekong riverside race in the Lao capital.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 at the Xaysetha Economic Zone in Vientiane, this Green Step-organised half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A Lao capital race with Mekong River connections.
verdict: The Mekong Half Marathon is a Vientiane road race organised by Green Step — a Lao social enterprise — at the Xaysetha Economic Zone along the Mekong River. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. September in Vientiane is the late rainy season, with warm, humid conditions and the Mekong at its fullest. For runners wanting a Lao half marathon with open registration and a community-organised feel, this is a solid, bookable option.

sections.heading: Vientiane: Mekong Riverside
paragraphs: The Xaysetha Economic Zone sits along the Mekong River in Vientiane, providing riverside road-running with views across to Thailand. [1] Green Step is a named Lao social enterprise, giving the race community-purpose credibility. Registration is open.
